verse: The Spirit of the Lord GOD is on Me, because the LORD has anointed Me to preach good news to the poor. He has sent Me to bind up the brokenhearted, to proclaim liberty to the captives and freedom to the prisoners,
story: Isaiah speaks as one whom the Spirit has anointed, and years later Jesus stands up in a synagogue in Nazareth and reads these very lines.

The anointed Servant has been sent with good news for the poor, healing for the brokenhearted, and liberty for those held captive. These are not abstract gifts. They are given to specific people in specific need: those with nothing, those with a broken heart, those behind locked doors. Jesus tells the synagogue that the words are fulfilled in their hearing. In His first coming He begins the year of the LORD's favor, and the rest of the promise waits for His return.
If you carry something broken into this season, this Servant was sent for people like you.
theme: Advent: waiting, promise, the coming King
